MAPPING.NAME: m_RETURNS_STG_TO_FACT_RETURNS
MAPPING.DESCRIPTION: Incremental insert of partner return lines into DW.FACT_RETURNS.

MAPPING_VARIABLE.NAME: $$LAST_RECEIVED_TS
MAPPING_VARIABLE.DESCRIPTION: High-water mark on RECEIVED_TS, stored in AUDIT.ETL_CONTROL.

TRANSFORMATION.NAME: LKP_FACT_ORDERS
TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: Looks up ORDER_SK in DW.FACT_ORDERS on ORDER_ID. Returns that arrive before their order get ORDER_SK = -1 and are re-pointed by the weekly late-arriving-orders fix-up job.

TRANSFORMATION.NAME: LKP_DIM_PRODUCT
TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: Looks up PRODUCT_SK in DW.DIM_PRODUCT on PRODUCT_ID.

TRANSFORMATION.NAME: FIL_DUPLICATES
TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: Drops rows whose (RETURN_ID, PRODUCT_ID) already exists in DW.FACT_RETURNS, which makes reruns of the same file idempotent.

FIELD_MAPPING.LOGIC: LKP_FACT_ORDERS; -1 when the order is not loaded yet

SESSION.NAME: s_m_RETURNS_STG_TO_FACT_RETURNS
SESSION.ON_FAILURE: Session fails; watermark not advanced. Rerun is safe because FIL_DUPLICATES skips rows already loaded.
